description:
• Environment management of eCommerce application.
• Environment management is comprised of deployment management, CI\CD, engineering team communication/collaboration, and troubleshooting of application environment.
• Troubleshooting is required up to identification of environment issue, but other teams can/will be engaged for resolution. 
• Responsible for cloud environment management from a PAAS perspective. 


 • Experience with production deployment to the cloud of an MVC application using microservices is a must.
• Experience with PAAS a must.
• Exposure/experience with Pivotal Cloud Foundry a plus. 
• Responsible for on-premise environment management 
• 8+ years developing .NET applications and involvement in the full development lifecycle a must. Tools development/implementation for the cloud will be part of the role. 

If you are interested in the role then please revert with an updated resume in word format.


 To discuss further about this position, please reach out to me at (973)-606-3249.
